description: On session end, append a structured session-end event (session id, reason, cwd) to the sidecar store (events.jsonl). This hook is the cadence point for the self-review protocol (AGENTS.md section 8, canonical skill `self-review`): on Claude Code the SessionEnd trigger is PROVEN, and the agent runs self-review during end-of-session hardening; the hook itself only records the end. Copilot sessionEnd delivery is PROVEN as a trigger (X5, ledger S19 amendment); the self-review action on Copilot remains a manual/weekly cadence. Delivery is per tool — see notes.
